column3: Can I name what the chart is doing in one sentence (trend / range / flip)?
Am I using a higher timeframe for context and a lower one for the entry?
Am I reading buyers and sellers - not drawing random lines?
Is the level clear in about 15 seconds? If not I skip.
Does the level have proof (touches / EMAs / value) - not a Fib alone?
Is my entry type clear (retest / EMA reclaim / breakout)?
Am I waiting for the full trigger - not the first break alone?
Do I have a hard stop written down?
Is the stop past the level that kills the idea?
Does ATR say the stop is not too tight and not crazy wide?
Is reward worth the risk (about 1.5R or better)?
Is size based on dollars I can lose - not a guess?
Did I check news / events that could wreck a clean chart?
Can I say: You can't regret a well thought out plan?
If any answer is No - I stay out.
